card.name: Small words before harm-related nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "a" or "be" right after a harm-related subject (overdose, poverty, hypotension), where a noun or verb about harm or treatment comes next. Also fires on a few nouns like "sins" or "questions".

modes.label: Linking word after harm subject
modes.description: "a" or "be" after a subject about poisoning, poverty or low blood pressure.
modes.example: Accidental overdose of iron-containing products is<< a>> leading cause of fatal poisoning in children under

modes.label: Passive "be" in overdose advice
modes.description: "be" after a list of problems like dehydration and hypotension, before "treated".
modes.example: Dehydration, electrolyte imbalance, and hypotension should<< be>> treated by established procedures.

modes.label: Moral or general nouns
modes.description: Nouns in religious or general prose such as sins or disputed questions.
modes.example: could only cover<< sins>>; they could not remove them. The

card.writes: Little clear effect; the promoted and suppressed tokens are a mixed set of unrelated words.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words just before a statement about harm, poisoning or hardship is completed.
